title: The Full Moon Recharge of September
skyStory: One hundred percent. The Pisces moon is completely, gloriously full, the Harvest Moon rising orange over the Atlantic like a pumpkin someone lit from the inside. Neptune has turned the fog machine off for the occasion. Every star has put on its best outfit. Saturn and Mars, for once, are standing side by side, not arguing, just admiring the view.

reading: Tonight is the Full Moon Recharge. Take off the onyx bracelet and set it on a windowsill, beside something red if Nancy's ruby is not with you, under the moonlight. While it charges, stand there and say one thing you are grateful for out loud. The cabin is listening. So is the chimney.

During the day, you will feel full too: full of words, full of plans, full of energy that wants somewhere to go. Give it a direction before you give it a volume. [[The Sun]] reversed in your spread whispers the lesson again: joy does not need to be earned before it can be held. Hold some tonight, under all that silver.
joel.mission: Rest the onyx beside a glass of water on the sill while the Harvest Moon climbs, then send Nancy proof that the water caught the glow.
joel.omen: A big orange moon on the horizon. A season of hard work is turning into harvest.

reading: Set the ruby beside your onyx bracelet tonight, on a sill or a table where the moon can find them both. Five stones, five elements, and tonight the Harvest Moon tops them all up like a lighthouse keeper filling the lamps. Fire, earth, water, wind, and heart, all humming at once.

The day itself will feel ripe, generous, full of small rewards. Someone will offer you something nice, a seat, a compliment, the last good mug. Take it. The [[Ten of Cups]] is sitting on your doorstep with a rainbow, and it would be terribly rude to leave it standing there.
nancy.mission: Line up all five of your stones together tonight in the moonlight and say each element's name out loud as you set them down.
nancy.omen: An orange glow on the water at moonrise. Something you planted in spring is ready to pick.

together.text: Full Moon Recharge, Harvest Moon edition. At the same agreed time tonight, place ruby and onyx side by side under the moon and send each other the photo. Say one thank you to each other, out loud, even if only the cat hears it.

game.intro: Full Moon Recharge night. Ruby and onyx are sunbathing in moonlight, so you two zoom in on something luminous.
game.prompt: Something in your home that glows after dark and is not a screen.
